stage.note: Civo is a founder-led, largely self-funded UK cloud provider (CEO Mark Boost previously built and exited LCN.com, ServerChoice, Ai Networks and Bulletproof Cyber). It ran a small public 'phase one' raise of $840k (per its own April 2021 blog post, via Hacker News) and took a $2M minority-stake investment from THG Ingenuity in September 2021. No institutional priced Series A/B/etc. round was found after that, so the last priced round (the THG Ingenuity minority investment) is classified here as seed-sized; no accelerator/YC participation was found.

total_funding_usd.basis: sum of Civo's own disclosures: $840k 'phase one' funding (Civo blog, April 2021, via HN) + $2,000,000 THG Ingenuity minority-stake investment (Civo blog, Sept 2021)
total_funding_usd.quote: THG Ingenuity invests $2 million for a minority stake in Civo

last_round.quote: THG Ingenuity invests $2 million for a minority stake in Civo, marking a strategic move to support growth and innovation in cloud technology.

note: Civo (Civo Ltd, London, founded 2015, CEO/founder Mark Boost) is a Kubernetes/cloud-compute provider now positioning itself as a 'Sovereign Cloud and AI platform' with public cloud, private cloud (CivoStack Enterprise, FlexCore) and GPU/AI offerings. It appears to be an independently owned, founder-led company that has taken only modest outside capital (a small 2021 public raise plus a $2M minority investment from THG Ingenuity) rather than large VC rounds; no accelerator participation, Series A+ round, or public revenue/ARR figures were found as of this check. It has made at least one acquisition (Kubefirst) per its newsroom.
